title: DeepReach | How Waze boosts local visibility for businesses

facts.fact: Waze was created in 2008 and was bought by Google in 2013.
facts.quote: Waze is a **GPS navigation app** created in 2008. It was bought by Google in 2013

facts.fact: Waze has no less than 16 million monthly users in France, per the page's statement.
facts.quote: the application has no less than 16 million monthly users in France and over 140 million users worldwide

facts.fact: Waze Ads offers a solution for companies with a large budget of up to $30,000 per month.
facts.quote: the advertising manager offers a solution for companies with a large budget: up to $30,000 per month

facts.fact: Waze verifies a local ads account within 24 hours after the location and budget steps are completed.
facts.quote: Waze verifies the account within 24 hours, and the company appears on the GPS map!

facts.fact: Waze Ads Pins display the establishment's current opening hours and special offers.
facts.quote: They also display current opening hours and special offers.

facts.fact: Waze Ads Takeovers display an announcement banner to users who are at a standstill for at least 4 seconds.
facts.quote: when they are at a completest and still for at least 4 seconds

facts.fact: Large-budget Waze Ads advantages include access to all advertising formats, telephone support, advanced targeting, and payment by invoice.
facts.quote: access to all advertising formats; telephone support; advanced targeting; payment by invoice.
